title: Route_32
lead_summary: Route 32 is a route that connects Union Cave to Violet City. There is also an access to the Ruins of Alph in the North-West and a PokéCenter to the South-East, but it has no Flight/Teleport Destination.

items.name: Hyper Potion
items.location_details: Hidden by a rock near the PokéCenter.

items.name: Fluffy Tail
items.location_details: By some grass near the PokéCenter.

items.name: Carbos
items.location_details: By some grass on the Western path.

items.name: TM05 Roar
items.location_details: On the higher ground near the crossroad.

items.name: X Accuracy
items.location_details: On the ground near Ruins of Alph.

items.name: Spaceship Part
items.location_details: On the higher ground near the crossroad, after starting the quest First Contact.
